svg.title: Bolted connector: soldered then tightened, vs tightened then soldered
svg.desc: Side views of a connector whose metal flange is bolted to the board, with three leads soldered through it. Left, marked wrong: the leads were soldered while the flange stood slightly off the board; tightening the bolts afterwards pulls the flange down, bending it and straining the solder joints, marked in red. Right, marked right: the bolts were tightened first, so the flange sits flat and the joints carry no strain.

g.text: Flange pulled down by the bolts
Give a torque for every screw and nut
